pages.text: The minimap sits in the corner of your screen. It shows players and your tamed pets.$(br2)Press $(l)M$() for the big world map.$(br2)Right-click on the world map to create a $(l)waypoint$(), so you can find a place again.
Press $(l)Y$() for minimap settings: size, what it shows and more.$(br2)Waypoints show on your minimap to point you in the right direction.
pages.title: Settings
